data.name: Bunderkin: The Ocular Eclipse
data.detailed_description:
Bunderkin: The Ocular Eclipse is a puzzle-heavy stealth action-adventure where you play as Beedee the Bunderdragon, the infamous outcast of Bunder Hollow, desperate to sneak into a once-in-a-lifetime festival celebrating the rare celestial event known as the Ocular Eclipse.

For generations, the kooky spooky festival has been a night of reinvention—where townsfolk embrace mantras of new beginnings, shedding their old selves, and living as if tomorrow may never come.

They should be careful what they wish for...

As our story unfolds, Beedee stumbles upon a lunatic's plot to freeze the positions of the moons, prevent the passing of the eclipse, and unthinkably enslave the townsfolk of Bunder Hollow via body-snatching parasites (known as the Oculi) hatched by the rare lunar rays of the Ocular Eclipse!

Inspired by the stylish whimsy of GameCube-era classics like The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker and the clock-ticking calamity of The Legend of Zelda: Majora’s Mask, Bunderkin: The Ocular Eclipse traps you in a 3-day time loop where you must MASTER EACH MOMENT AND LIVE THE PERFECT DAY—or watch the town that despises you fall into darkness.

Help Beedee memorize the rhythms of his hometown: where villagers wander, when events unfold, and how small actions can ripple into big outcomes. Work within tight margins in time, earn access to hidden places, and avoid dangers as you experiment with each repeating loop.

With every reset, players gain the knowledge needed to outmaneuver enemies, uncover hidden truths, and piece together the perfect sequence of actions needed to stop the catastrophe before time resets once more.

Each day the town changes.

  • Day One: Festival preparations fill the streets as excitement builds for the upcoming eclipse.

  • Day Two: Something begins to feel wrong as townsfolk start behaving strangely and acting out-of-self.

  • Day Three: Chaos erupts as the Oculi outlive their natural cycle and the town descends toward a creeping apocalypse.

    This game has it all!

Time travel, enchanted masks, side quests, upgradable gear, and a variety of tools and weapons combine as players solve cause-and-effect puzzles and sneak their way through a living town caught on the brink of unpredicted disaster!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: 64-bit Windows 7/8.1/10/11
  • Processor: AMD FX-6100/Intel i3-3220 or Equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Radeon RX 6500 XT 4GB/NVIDIA RTX 4GB or Equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS *: 64-bit Windows 7/8.1/10/11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 2600X/Intel i7-6700K or Equivalent
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX Vega 56 8GB/ Nvidia RTX 3070 8GB or Equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 12 Monterey
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i5 (Quad-core 2.5 GHz+)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 integrated GPU or Radeon Pro 560 equivalent
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires Metal support
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 13 Ventura or newer
  • Processor: Apple M1 Pro / M2 or Intel Core i7 (Quad-core 3.0 GHz+)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 Pro / M2 GPU or Radeon Pro 5700 XT equivalent
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD strongly recommended for streaming environments

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 / SteamOS 3.0
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 (6GB) / AMD RX 580
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Vulkan compatible GPU required
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 / SteamOS 3.0+
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700 / Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / AMD RX 6600
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Latest proprietary GPU drivers recommended
